operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Adds an attendance log. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The request body is a flat JSON object. Only `staff_id` and `time` are required; every other field is optional. The combination of `time` + `staff_id` must be unique — posting the same pair twice fails.

The `status` and `source_type` value tables below are the recognized sets; note the API does not currently validate them on input — an unrecognized value is accepted (stored coerced), not rejected.

`status` defaults to `draft` when omitted:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| draft | Draft |
| sign_in | Sign In |
| sign_out | Sign Out |
| repeated_sign_in | Repeated Sign In |
| repeated_sign_out | Repeated Sign Out |
| invalid | Invalid |
| unknown_employee | Unknown Employee |

`source_type`, when supplied, is one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| machine | Machine |
| supervisor | Supervisor |
| file | File |
| self | Self |

staff_id.description: Required. Id of the employee the log belongs to.

time.description: Required. Log timestamp, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Must be unique per employee (`time` + `staff_id`).

status.description:
Optional. Defaults to `draft` when omitted. Recognized values are below, but note this field is **not validated on input** — an unrecognized value is accepted and stored coerced (empty), not rejected.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| draft | Draft |
| sign_in | Sign In |
| sign_out | Sign Out |
| repeated_sign_in | Repeated Sign In |
| repeated_sign_out | Repeated Sign Out |
| invalid | Invalid |
| unknown_employee | Unknown Employee |

session_id.description: Optional. Id of the attendance session the log belongs to.

source_type.description:
Optional. Recognized source values below (not validated on input):

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| machine | Machine |
| supervisor | Supervisor |
| file | File |
| self | Self |

source_id.description: Optional. Id of the source that produced the log.

source_method.description: Optional. How the source recorded the log.

id.description: Id of the newly created attendance log.

400.description: The attendance log could not be saved — for example the `time` + `staff_id` combination already exists.

error.description: Reason the record could not be saved — for example a duplicate `time` + `staff_id` combination.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

422.description: A required field is missing or invalid. `errors` maps each failing field to its messages (e.g. `staff_id` or `time` omitted).

errors.description: Per-field validation messages, keyed by field name.
